title: Collectables - Brain in a Jar Guide
subtitle: How to start A Matter of Matter in Skyline Valley, what Dr. Regina Marcs wants with all those brains, how the hand-ins and the finale work, and every reward for collecting all 150 Brains in Jars.

sections.title: How to Start A Matter of Matter
sections.html:
Brains in Jars are glass containers with a brain floating inside. There are 150 of them: 148 in Skyline Valley, 2 in Savage Divide. You don't need to do anything to start the quest. The first time you pick one up, your Pip-Boy picks up a signal with coordinates to a "recall" location and A Matter of Matter starts with the objective Find the source of the signal.

Step 1 – Pick up any Brain in a Jar

Any brain will do. Each jar makes a beeping noise that gets louder the closer you get, so listen out for it. If you want the closest one to a fast travel point, start with Brain in a Jar 1 at Three Ponds (see the location pages below).

Step 2 – Follow the signal to Rapidan Camp

The coordinates lead to Rapidan Camp in Skyline Valley, and specifically to the Brown House. Fast travel to Rapidan Camp, follow the quest marker to the Brown House and go inside.

Step 3 – Speak to the Ghoul

Inside is a Ghoul who isn't pleased to see you and warns you she's armed. Talk to her and she soon notices the brain jar you're carrying. She is Dr. Regina Marcs, and she's collecting the brains.

Step 4 – Make the deal

Hand over your brain and Marcs gives you a new weapon, the V63-Z Custom, a two-handed blade she calls "very fancy chopping power". She promises upgrades for it and recordings decoded from the brains if you keep bringing more. From here the objective is Collect brains in jars, then Return brain jars to Marcs.

sections.title: Handing In Brains to Dr. Marcs
sections.html:
Marcs takes the brains in 15 batches. Each batch is bigger than the last, and the quest objective shows how many you still need for the next one. Finishing the quest takes 60 brains in total, so you don't need all 150 for the quest itself.

Every time you hand in a batch, Marcs pays you some caps and gives you a holotape she has decoded from the brains. There are 15 of these Scan holotapes in total, listed further down. Listen as you go: they tell the story of where the brains came from and what Marcs is really after.

Each brain you pick up is worth a base of 400 XP. Brains in Jars can't be dropped, traded or sold.

sections.title: The Finale (spoilers)
sections.html:
When you hand in the final batch, Marcs asks you to help her open a bunker hidden below the Brown House. She says the man inside may have gone feral, so expect a fight. You can say no and walk away with your rewards, but she makes it clear there's a bonus if you escort her down.

Step 1 – Get the last tape

Agree to help and Marcs gives you the last holotape she decoded. It's a set of song lyrics, and it's the key to the bunker.

Step 2 – Follow Marcs downstairs

Tell her you're ready and follow her down to the bunker door. Marcs says the password is 565 characters long, the length of the song's lyrics without spaces or punctuation. She types it in for you and the door opens.

The password, if you want to see it:

Step 3 – Find Iggy

The man inside is Iggy Stolz, and he's already dead. Ask Marcs about it and the truth comes out: she shot him herself after he stole her weather machine plans, and he crawled down here before he died.

Step 4 – Deal with Marcs

Marcs wants to tie up loose ends, and you're one of them. The quest then turns into Kill Marcs or Flee the Brown House. Some answers in the conversation let you talk your way out of it; most end in a fight. Either way, finishing the quest pays 1,200 caps, XP and a Skyline Valley loot roll.

sections.title: The Brain Jar CAMP Item
sections.html: Finishing A Matter of Matter unlocks the Brain Jar for your CAMP. It costs 2 Steel, 2 Boiled Water, 2 Brain Fungus, and you can place up to 10 of them.

sections.title: The Story Behind the Brains (spoilers)
sections.html:
Marcs was once Lieutenant Regina Marcs of Vault 63, where she led the weather manipulation research for a time, trading the job back and forth with Audrey Stolz. She came to Vault 63 from Atlas Observatory, along with Oberlin.

The brains come from a "Brain Bleaching" operation the Stolz family ran on the west coast, at Chez Alpine: Spa and Resort. Rich and famous guests, mostly from the film industry, were treated there by the "world-renowned Dr. Scheinmenn", and the recordings show Iggy Stolz interviewing them. Iggy was Hugo Stolz's adopted son, raised as the heir until Audrey was born.

Iggy was hunting for a secret in the brains: a musical called Sonny, O' My Boy that he believed Hugo had written for him. Marcs, meanwhile, wanted her own improved version of the weather machine plans, which Iggy stole. She decoded the brains to find the password Iggy set on the bunker, and in the end she tells you she is "an agent of America. The real one."

sections.title: Lifetime Milestone Rewards
sections.html:
Lifetime challenges count every Brain in a Jar you find, whether or not you are doing the quest. They pay out at set milestones:

  • 1 brain: Caps (100)
  • 5 brains: V63-Z Custom - Static Turbine Recipe
  • 25 brains: V63-Z Custom - Kinetic Amplifier Recipe
  • 50 brains: V63-Z Custom - Shockwave Concussor Recipe
  • 76 brains: V63-Z Custom - Overclocked Capacitor Recipe
  • 100 brains: V63-Z Custom - Jet Thrusters Recipe
  • 125 brains: V63-Z Custom - Aftershock Blade Recipe
  • 150 brains: Plan: Retaliator's

Tick them off on the Brain in a Jar Reward Checklist.

sections.title: FAQ and Important Info
sections.html:
Do I have to do the quest to get the lifetime rewards?

No. The lifetime challenges count every brain you find, all the way to 150. The quest only needs 60 brains handed in to Marcs.

How much XP is each brain worth?

A base of 400 XP every time you pick one up.

Can I give spare brains to a friend?

No. Brains in Jars can't be dropped, traded or sold.

Is there a way to find the brains without a guide?

Yes. Every jar makes a beeping noise that gets louder the closer you get to it. Follow the beeping and you'll find it.

Where do I start the route?

At Three Ponds. The pages follow one route, so work through them in order. Each page tells you which fast travel point to start from.
